use IO.Std.write_line

is_prime(value: long) -> bool is
    if value < 2L then return false fi

    let divisor mut = 2L

    while divisor * divisor <= value do
        if value % divisor == 0L then return false fi
        divisor = divisor + 1L
    od

    true
si

let prime_total mut = 0L
let prime_index mut = 0
let last_prime mut = 1L

let composite_total mut = 0L
let composite_index mut = 0
let last_composite mut = 3L

take_prime() is
    do
        last_prime = last_prime + 1L

        if is_prime(last_prime) then break fi
    od

    prime_index = prime_index + 1
    prime_total = prime_total + last_prime

take_composite() is
    do
        last_composite = last_composite + 1L

        if !is_prime(last_composite) then break fi
    od

    composite_index = composite_index + 1
    composite_total = composite_total + last_composite
si

take_prime()
take_composite()

write_line("sums that are both the first n primes "

let found mut = 0

    if prime_total == composite_total then
        write_line("  n = {prime_index,6} m = {composite_index,6} "

        found = found + 1
        take_prime()
    elif prime_total < composite_total then
        take_prime()
